name: Honey Lemon Soda
description: After middle school, with its bullying and nicknames, Uka Ishimori is excited for a fresh start at Hachimitsu High School. Kai Miura, a cool and uninhibited boy, sits next to her in class. Uka remembers she met Kai in middle school and with a single word, he had convinced her to attend Hachimitsu. Though he’s popular, Kai supports Uka in her efforts to fit in with her new classmates.

videos.title: Because I Met You
videos.overview: After a bad experience in junior high, where her social anxiety was worsened by bullying, Uka Ishimori decides to change herself and the way she lives her life. Her first step is applying to Hachimitsu High School. Its attractions? A more relaxed school atmosphere, and the gruff but handsome Kai Miura.

videos.title: Turning Into a Treasure
videos.overview: Uka displays some hidden talents that even she didn't know about. Meanwhile, Kai is being strangely mean to her her for some reason... Is it a misguided attempt to keep her safe?

videos.title: Our Little Secret
videos.overview: Uka's happier than she ever dreamed. It's all new friends and new miracles until an incident on a school trip.

videos.title: However Distant We May Be
videos.overview: Uka struggles to open up to her class about her past. A friend of Kai's undermines her confidence further.

videos.title: A Great Person
videos.overview: Uka has a revelation about her own psychology thanks to Serina, Kai's ex-girlfriend.

videos.title: In the Future, Too...
videos.overview: Uka and her friends are working hard on the culture festival. She's determined to make their café a success!

videos.title: I’m Sorry I Love Him
videos.overview: Uka and Serina struggle to open up about their feelings. Can they figure it out over summer break?

videos.title: Summon the Courage
videos.overview: It's summer break! Uka, Serina, and Kai all summon their courage and communicate.

videos.title: Goodbye, Bumbling Self
videos.overview: Uka's father is concerned about Hachimitsu High again. Can he be convinced that it's the right place for her?

videos.title: The Side of You No One Knows
videos.overview: Uka ponders the nature of her relationship with Kai. What are they to each other?

videos.title: Feelings Burst Free
videos.overview: Everyone in Uka's class is discussing love. Is it better to hide your feelings, or let them fly free?

videos.title: Honey Lemon Soda
videos.overview: Uka and Kai try to figure out the new development in their relationship... as the whole school watches.
